content: Camillian Hospital, also known as San Camillo Hospital, is a small private healthcare facility situated in Bangkok, Thailand. It was established by Catholic missionaries belonging to the Camillian order. The hospital is located in the Watthana district of Bangkok. It provides both general medical services and specialized care to its patients. The institution is managed by the Saint Camillus Foundation of Thailand, which also runs charitable programs aimed at providing medical treatment to individuals from low-income backgrounds and those living in poverty. Notably, the staff of Camillian Hospital played a significant role in addressing the aftermath of the 2004 tsunami in Thailand by organizing and operating mobile clinics to deliver medical care to survivors of the disaster.
